fusions.name: Feinting Flick
fusions.desc: A false flick deals 4 damage to the first enemy it reaches, with a 15% chance to turn it against its own side for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Last Coin Lifted
fusions.desc: A lash at an enemy at or below 30% health that deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more for each one.

fusions.name: Gone Behind the Crack
fusions.desc: Veils you for 5 seconds and you move 15% faster while veiled. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Pocketed Winnings
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your critical hit chance rises by 20% for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
